title: learncroc card
description: nodes/<id>.yaml: one card (hook, 2–3 beats, close) and its item bank.

title.description: ≤ 6 words; must not give the close away (L005).

tagline.description: One line on the card's peek.

bigIdea.description: For authors, the croc and lint; never shown as a reading block.

concepts.description: Shared concept ids for cross-pack bridges, e.g. "llm.attention".

visual.description: Anchor visual for beats without their own.

screens.description: 2–3 beats (L006); the schema allows 1–3 so that drafts parse.

cards.description: Typed cards. When present they are THE stop (played in order); hook/screens/close are derived (legacyFromCards).

flashcards.description: 3–6; generated from recall items when omitted.

toy.description: Parked. Explore mode, goal omitted; prompt ≤ 20 words.

faq.description: ≤ 3; the croc's offline answers; a ≤ 60 words.

status.description: "reviewed" requires a pack.lock.yaml review covering this file (L017).

WidgetRef.description: A configured built-in widget. Pick an id to get autocomplete for its props and goal.

anyOf.title: Probability bars
anyOf.description: A next-token probability chart. The learner drags bars to predict the distribution, ranks the candidates, turns a temperature dial and samples from it, picks a token, or runs the score→pick→append loop by hand. Use when: Next-token prediction, temperature or sampling is the idea: what the model thinks comes next, how sure it is, and how one token at a time builds a sentence.

hideTruth.description: Hide the real bars until answered.

source.description: "precomputed:gpt2" renders "computed with GPT-2"; "illustrative" renders a tag.

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

anyOf.title: Token splitter
anyOf.description: Text shatters into the tokens a model actually reads (cl100k_base, the GPT-4 tokenizer), with ids. The learner types, predicts token counts, crafts strings that meet token rules, or taps a token. Use when: Tokenisation is the idea: words aren't tokens, a leading space changes the token, rare words split into pieces, counts surprise.

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

anyOf.title: Attention weights
anyOf.description: Arcs from one token to every token it can see, thick where attention is high. The learner shares a budget of 100% across the words, taps the words that matter, or swaps a word and watches the arcs redraw. Optional causal mask. Use when: Which earlier words a token looks at, and why: pronoun resolution (“it” → “trophy”), agreement, the causal mask, attention as a weighted average that always sums to 1.

focus.description: Index of the token doing the looking.

causal.description: Dim tokens after focus (cannot be attended).

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

anyOf.title: Embedding plane
anyOf.description: A 2D meaning map: words that mean similar things sit close together. The learner drags words to where they feel they belong (then the real projected positions slide in), finds a word's nearest neighbour, or completes an analogy arrow like king − man + woman. Use when: Meaning as position: similar words cluster, directions carry relationships (analogies), and nearest neighbours show what a model treats as related.

placeable.description: Point ids the learner places (start in a tray; true xy revealed after).

showNeighbors.description: Show k nearest for a selected point.

source.description: precomputed = a 2D projection of real embeddings; the projection is named in the caption.

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

anyOf.title: Plot
anyOf.description: A function, data or bar chart with parameter sliders, live readouts, a draggable marker and an optional draw-your-prediction mode. Use when: A relationship between two quantities matters: tuning a parameter to hit a target, reading a value, or predicting a curve's shape.

markerAt.description: x position of a static marker (e.g. set by a reveal).

drawPrediction.description: "You draw it" before the truth appears.

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

anyOf.title: Sorter
anyOf.description: Drag cards into labelled buckets, or rank them in a single column. Use when: The learner should classify 3–8 examples into 2–4 categories, or put steps or quantities in order.

rankLabels.description: Ends of the rank column, e.g. ["first", "last"].

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

anyOf.title: Hotspot
anyOf.description: A picture with marked parts. The learner taps the right parts, or drags labels onto them. Use when: Parts of a diagram matter: a circuit, an eye, a code listing, a map, a chart's features.

viewBox.description: Width, height of the image coordinate space.

labels.description: label mode: draggable labels (may include distractors).

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

anyOf.title: A/B compare
anyOf.description: Two versions of the same thing: side by side, flipped like a card, or wiped across like a before/after photo. The learner picks A, B or (if allowed) the same. Use when: Contrasting cases: two versions that differ in one important way (two headlines, two charts, two sentences, two designs), so the difference itself is the lesson.

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

anyOf.title: Light clock
anyOf.description: A light clock between two mirrors 4 units apart, seen from the platform or the train; trace, speed and γ tasks, tick counters and the 3-4-5 triangle. Use when: Time dilation and the γ factor: why a moving clock ticks slower (longer diagonal at the same c), mutual dilation via the frame switch, or hitting a γ target with the speed slider.

highlight.description: Emphasise one clock (used by choice visualState).

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

anyOf.title: Train scene
anyOf.description: Einstein's train: a lamp in mid-car, lightning at both ends, or a headlight, seen from the train or the platform, with slow motion, a time scrubber and a 'subtract light-travel time' stopwatch. Use when: Relativity of simultaneity (lamp: platform sees the rear wall lit first; lightning: the passenger concludes the front strike came first) or the constancy of light speed (headlight: c in every frame).

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

anyOf.title: Spacetime diagram
anyOf.description: A Minkowski diagram (c = 1, light at 45°) with draggable events, bendable worldlines, light cones, a boost slider that tilts the axes, simultaneity lines and proper-time, interval and order readouts. Use when: Event order and simultaneity across frames, causality (light cones), proper time along worldlines and the twin paradox.

boost.description: Observer velocity; omit to hide the slider.

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

anyOf.title: Tile builder
anyOf.description: Build a sentence (or a program, Parsons-style, with indentation) from tiles; gender and number agreement show as shape and colour; the finished sentence can be read aloud. Use when: Producing a sentence or a few lines of code from given pieces: word order, agreement (tags m/f/sg/pl), Parsons problems, and the 'I'm stuck' scaffold for explain answers.

meaning.description: Prompt in the learner's language, e.g. "The red houses".

speak.description: Play the built sentence on commit (pack audio, else TTS).

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

anyOf.title: Dialogue
anyOf.description: A branching conversation with a character: lines with audio and a translation toggle, reply choices that can change state (Lola's speed dial), and typed replies checked accent-tolerantly. Use when: A realistic exchange (ordering, asking for help, persuading) where the learner chooses or produces replies; boss set pieces like dinner in Sevilla.

line.description: What the character says (target language allowed).

audio.description: Filled by the compiler from packs:audio.

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

anyOf.title: Listen
anyOf.description: Play a phrase at natural or slow speed (pack audio, else the browser's voice), then pick or type what was said; or shadow it: record yourself in memory, play it next to the model line, and rate yourself. The transcript is always available after answering, or whenever audio can't play. Use when: Listening comprehension or pronunciation practice in a language pack.

src.description: Pre-rendered audio (required in curated language packs and in bosses/placement, L021).

tts.description: Web Speech fallback; one of src/tts required.

task.description: Default "identify"; shadow = record yourself, compare, self-rate.

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

anyOf.title: Code stepper
anyOf.description: Step through a short program (≤ 20 lines) with a precomputed trace; at marked steps the learner predicts a variable, the output or the next line before it is revealed. Variables show as name tags or boxes. Use when: How a program runs line by line: assignment, loops, conditionals, output.

goal.description: Required when used as an interaction or item; omitted for visuals.

AssetPath.description: Pack-relative asset path. No ".." segment; .html only under assets/interactive/. The resolved real path must stay under the pack root (checked by the loader, not here).

GeneratedHtmlVisual.description: Pocket maps only, local only, sandbox origin, ≤ 64 KB, validated before use.

Provenance.description: How an AI- or script-generated file or value was made.

IsoDate.description: "2026-10-20T08:00:00Z" (a plain date "2026-10-20" is also accepted in files).

label.description: The wrong belief, stated as a belief.

upstream.description: Optional ancestor node id: the card a checkpoint miss points back to when it isn't the item's own card.

Markdown.description: Inline Markdown: bold, italic, code, http(s) links or stop:<nodeId>. No raw HTML, no links into assets/. `$…$` maths allowed.

blocks.description: Hook total ≤ 30 words: blocks + prompt + options longer than 6 words (L001).

interaction.description: Always excluded from tuning and grading credit; may set confidence: true.

lotsGuess.description: Option id commonly guessed → "Lots of people guess …".

style.description: For the AI judge and analytics; not shown.

SayBlock.description: One line from Moss, the guide (≤ 35 words, lint). `outside`: the line goes beyond the source article.

MathBlock.description: KaTeX display math; doesn't count toward the word cap.

CodeBlock.description: Display only; doesn't count toward the word cap.

AudioBlock.description: `src` is filled by the compiler from `packs:audio` renders.

QuoteBlock.description: ≤ 40 words; counts toward the word cap.

HookInteraction.description: Hooks are always excluded from tuning and grading credit.

ItemId.description: Unique within a node: hook, screen interactions, items and flashcards share one namespace.

visualState.description: The canvas acts out what this answer would mean (required on widget canvases, L019).

props.description: Merged into the canvas widget's props (validated by its schema).

note.description: ≤ 8 words, drawn by WidgetHost as a label pinned on the canvas.

FallbackInteraction.description: A built-in interaction used where a widget, html interactive or explain can't run (a11y, old engines, offline explain). `id` is optional here.

speaker.description: An in-world character only (a waiter, a customer). No guides.

visual.description: Canvas (the beat's illustration); ignored if interaction.kind is "widget" or "html".

blocks.description: The beat's teaching text. Beat total ≤ 120 words: blocks + prompt + reveal + long options (L001).

interaction.description: The beat's small action. Optional per beat; ≥ 1 beat per card has one (L006).

reveal.description: Required when interaction is set (L006); forbidden otherwise.

alts.description: Each ≤ 60 words; the croc's offline "explain it differently" and "another example".

src.description: Source ids, or paragraph ids ("p12") for pocket maps.

Screen.description: A teach beat. YAML key `screens`, run phase "screen"; designers say "beat".

HtmlGoal.description: Graded on the host from the frame's last `report`.

keywords.description: Phrases/synonyms for offline highlight matching (case- and accent-insensitive).

visualState.description: Applied to the canvas after answering.

byGuess.description: Guess key → a close that names that guess, ≤ 60 words each (keys: allowedGuessKeys, checked by L023).

IntroCard.description: Article opening (quote) + Moss lines; the player derives the questions list from the other stops' ask cards.

AskCard.description: The stop's question. Hunches are optional chips, never graded.

Hunch.description: A hunch chip on an ask card; never graded.

TryCard.description: Graded like a beat: retry, hints, worked answer after 2 misses.

CheckCard.description: One shot: any answer is recorded and the card is done; feedback for every option is shown.

answers.description: The ask card id this answers.

TakeawayCard.description: The answer to an ask card (≤ 60 words, "Because…"); `byHunch` keys: hunch id | "idk" | "typed".

Item.description: A bank item: an interaction plus tuning fields.

vars.description: Candidate values per variable, e.g. { n: [200, 400, 900] }; the prompt uses {n}.

answerExpr.description: core/expr.ts expression over the vars; `answer` = its value for the first value of each var.

ItemParams.description: Numeric and estimate only: fresh numbers per instance.

Flashcard.description: A spaced-repetition flashcard (FSRS). Never called a "card" in the UI.
